page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor configured with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. The system includes 128 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The processor features 48 MB of L3 cache and supports specialized instruction sets including AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The server contains no integrated local storage and includes zero GPU accelerators. Networking performance is established at a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned.

Benchmark results show balanced compute output, scoring 36,598.86 on the PassMark CPU test and 13,329.0 on the Geekbench multi-core evaluation, placing overall processing capability in the middle tier of tested hardware. Memory subsystem performance ranks in the upper quartile, marked by a PassMark memory score of 2,775.46 and uncached large-block read speeds reaching 153.99 GB/sec. Lightweight AI inference utilizing AVX-512 VNNI yields top-quartile performance in small-model text generation at 304.16 tokens per second. The primary hardware tradeoff is the total reliance on remote network-attached disks due to the absence of local NVMe storage.

This server type presents a balanced resource profile suitable for horizontal enterprise scaling without the cost overhead of unneeded GPU hardware or extreme memory allocations. It is technically appropriate for running intermediate relational databases, enterprise web applications, caching tiers such as Redis clusters, containerized application fleets, and software compilation pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a dedicated general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It features a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor offering 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyperthreading, matched with 128 GB of system memory to maintain a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory allocation. The processor incorporates 48 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 and cryptographic instruction sets. Hardware accelerators and local disk storage are not included, requiring external network-attached volumes, while network performance is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Benchmark testing demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance across multi-core CPU evaluations and top-quartile results in memory subsystem speed and lightweight vector-assisted model inference. With dedicated vCPU assignment and stable throughput, the instance provides qualitative resource balance for multi-threaded enterprise services, intermediate database hosting, large application backends, and continuous integration build environments.
